Visitor customizes figure and figcaption elements

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

type testVisitorVisitorFigureCustom struct {
	htmd.BaseVisitor
}

func (v *testVisitorVisitorFigureCustom) VisitFigcaption(ctx htmd.NodeContext, text string) htmd.VisitResult {
	return htmd.VisitResultCustom(fmt.Sprintf(`*%s*`, text))
}

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	visitor := &testVisitorVisitorFigureCustom{}
	options.Visitor = visitor
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<article><h1>Article Title</h1><p>Introduction paragraph.</p><figure><img src="diagram.png" alt="System architecture diagram"><figcaption>Figure 1: System Architecture</figcaption></figure><p>Explanation of the figure.</p></article>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
